description: Antwork is a social media scheduler for ChatGPT: it drafts, schedules and publishes posts to your connected social accounts and reports how they perform. It connects LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest accounts to a workspace, then drafts posts that match the voice of the account's own recent posts, attaches images or video, schedules them for a chosen time or publishes them immediately, and reports back on engagement. Typical workflows are drafting and publishing a single post, planning and scheduling a week of content across accounts, attaching media from the chat or the workspace library, reviewing the content calendar, and checking which published posts performed best.

defaultPrompt: Draft a LinkedIn post about what I shipped this week.
Schedule tomorrow's Instagram post for 9:00 am.
Which of my posts performed best this month?

positive.description: Draft a LinkedIn post in the voice of the account's recent posts, saved as a draft only.
positive.prompt: Draft a LinkedIn post about launching our new scheduling feature. Just save it as a draft for now.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one draft for the workspace's connected LinkedIn account, written in the style of that account's recent posts, and shows it in a post card with status Draft. Nothing is published or scheduled.

positive.description: Schedule a LinkedIn post for a specific time in the coming days instead of publishing it now.
positive.prompt: Write a short LinkedIn post about our office move and schedule it for the day after tomorrow at 9:00 am.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the draft, asks the user to confirm before scheduling, then confirms the post is scheduled for 09:00 two days from today in the workspace timezone. The post card shows status Scheduled and the post can still be edited or deleted before that time. Posts can be scheduled up to 30 days ahead, so the date is relative rather than fixed.

positive.description: Attach an image the user uploads in the chat to a new LinkedIn draft.
positive.prompt: Create a LinkedIn draft announcing our new coffee blend and attach this image.
positive.expected_behavior: Stores the uploaded image in the workspace media library, attaches it to the new draft, and shows the post card with the caption and the image. Nothing is published.

positive.description: Review the content calendar for an upcoming date range.
positive.prompt: Show my content calendar for the next 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders a calendar view covering today through 30 days from today, listing each scheduled post with its account and time, including any post scheduled earlier in the conversation. If nothing is scheduled in that range, the calendar renders empty for that range.

positive.description: Report which published posts performed best.
positive.prompt: Which of my published posts got the most engagement over the past year?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a table of the workspace's published posts from the last 365 days ranked by engagement, with per-platform totals, and names the top performing post.

negative.description: Do not trigger for reading or replying to a personal inbox.
negative.prompt: Reply to the email from my accountant and tell her the invoice is paid.

negative.description: Do not trigger for paid advertising, which is adjacent but out of scope.
negative.prompt: Set up a $500 LinkedIn ad campaign targeting product managers in Spain.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general writing help with no account or publishing intent.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between reach and impressions on social platforms.

publication.release_notes: Repackaged for plugin upload. Fixes the Terms of Service link, and the scheduling test case now uses a date inside the 30-day scheduling window.

es-ES.subtitle: Programa y publica posts
es-ES.description: Antwork es un programador de redes sociales para ChatGPT: redacta, programa y publica posts en tus cuentas conectadas e informa de cómo funcionan. Conecta cuentas de LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube y Pinterest a un espacio de trabajo, redacta publicaciones con el estilo de las publicaciones recientes de cada cuenta, adjunta imágenes o vídeo, las programa para la hora que elijas o las publica al momento, e informa de la interacción. Usos habituales: redactar y publicar una publicación, planificar y programar una semana de contenido en varias cuentas, adjuntar archivos del chat o de la biblioteca, revisar el calendario de contenido y ver qué publicaciones funcionaron mejor.
